typed_entry_ABI.Execute: MSVC32 u32 __stdcall Execute(tagCOMMAND_DATA*),callee pops4; u32 status is separate from output/result flags. Native C++/access faults are not invented status returns.
typed_entry_ABI.byte_rules: Object words are little-endian x86; only the explicitly parsed wire DTC pairs/triples/fields are BE. u8/u16 truncations, signed counts, wrapped lengths and masked shifts remain native behavior.
typed_entry_ABI.command: Six pointer slots: +0=request/context,+4=output,+8=plugin-specific control/result,+C=CCommFrameCtrl/shared adapter,+10=CDataCtrl,+14=extra. Per-entry guards and pre-guard dereferences are authoritative.
typed_entry_ABI.context: ECU commonlyu32+1C; request operation/flags vary by plugin: ordinary read operation+20; MAIN P6 flags+24 and log mode+28; J1979-2 flags+20. Do not impose one layout.
typed_entry_ABI.shared_methods: Exact decorated export is authoritative ABI; most methods __thiscall ECX=this, static CGetDiagCodeFunc.GetDTCFuncAddrInfo is __cdecl(dataCtrl*,ECUu32,outAddressu32*,outTypeu16*). Ghidra guessed signature/omitted ECX is not proof.
